text:
Both assistants provide five award-winning documentaries with accurate descriptions and relevant awards. Assistant A selects five Oscar winners for Best Documentary Feature (2005–2015), covering nature, climate, a high-wire feat, surveillance, and a music biography. Assistant B chooses a mix of Oscar winners and major festival honorees (1994–2016), focusing on animal rights, racial justice, historical reenactment, captivity, and a longitudinal sports story. Both lists are diverse, well-described, and highly useful for aspiring filmmakers. Neither clearly surpasses the other in helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, depth, creativity, or detail.
